compatibility_notes: All reported outcomes and models remain mandatory, distinct specifications. Internal labor market versus hierarchy is a reported pair of models, not permission to select the more favorable one. Origin labels identify closest textual readings, not empirically selected solutions. Null/unknown origins must be resolved before execution. Do not cross product incompatible branches: zero-coded training cannot be logged without another explicit rule; reference-sample choices depend on duplicate and missingness rules; manager ratio and employment denominator must agree; nested tests require identical rows and industry design; any reparameterization must be converted to the original estimand. Explicit controls are fixed within the equivalent set. No alternative is selected using targets.
